run_mamba_text_generation: run the Mamba model generator to produce text from interactive prompts via CLI
create_mamba_generator: create a PackedCausalMambaGenerator with a config, LMMamba model, and tokenizer
generate_next_token_mamba: generate the next token from a Mamba model using the ssm_update implementation
prefill_mamba_model: run the prefill forward pass on tokenized prompts with cumulative sequence lengths
clear_mamba_cache: clear the SSM StateCache for all SSM modules in the Mamba model
